RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A captured enemy is dragged before the lord, who decides what becomes of him.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} of the {FACTION} was brought in with {PETITIONER_possessive} hands tied and stood where the petitioners stand. {PETITIONER_pronoun} has asked for nothing. The hall has offered nothing.

{DOSSIER}

{PETITIONER_possessive} people would pay {SILVER} silver to have {PETITIONER_objective} back, or so the last trader who dealt with them says.

How does the lord rule?

li.label: Sell {PETITIONER_objective} back to {PETITIONER_possessive} people for {SILVER} silver
